title: Shinonome Akito — Committed Actor〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really...?
Your class is making a film?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are.
Something about making the most of our youth or whatever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I do agree with that.
Making a film as a class certainly sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, what kinda film are you making? Have you guys already decided?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! An action film!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, action! That sounds wonderful!
What's the story going to be like?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, it's a post-apocalyptic setting...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Post-apocalyptic...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone's struggling to get enough food to eat, and these Dark Cooks go around hoarding everything for themselves!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's where the Wandering Cook comes in.
He fights against the Dark Cooks to bring delicious food to all those who really need it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
That's quite a unique plot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I think it's kinda cool...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A wandering hero battling against evildoers is romantic to say the least!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Akito, Shiraishi, how will you be assisting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're both gonna be acting in it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll be the girl who the Wandering Cook tries to save! And can you guess who Akito's playing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's the lead!

rows.Speaker: Luka, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-He's the lead...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you guys making a fuss about it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course we are!
Getting to be the lead is a huge deal!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, Akito, I think you're going to make for a wonderful hero.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
Especially since you have more guts than the average person, and a straightforward personality!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You think so...?
I'm still having trouble imagining myself as him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I didn't really have a choice when it came to who I'd be playing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, one of our classmates who can do stunts was originally supposed to be the lead, but it turns out that acting isn't really his thing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He and I are the same height and build, so we decided that I'll play the lead while he does all the stunts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Now we understand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I think it's good that you get to be the hero now! I mean, you're probably pretty good at acting...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, because of how he acts politely around others...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, guys...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do agree that you seem like a different person in those situations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's just me minding my manners...
What does that have to do with acting?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha♪
By the way, An, how do you feel about your acting chops?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me? I dunno, but I should be fine!
I was the lead for a school play this one time when I was little!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so bad at acting. I always get so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How about you, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I remember doing a couple shows with Tsukasa when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I recall enjoying myself, but... I'm not sure about my acting skills either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
But having fun is still probably the most important thing, yes?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
She's right!
So, we hope you two have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Having fun is important, but we should also do our best to make our film good.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You gotta beat up as many Dark Cooks as you can, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, since we're doing this, we should do our best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Agreed!
